description: This file contains test utilities and mock classes used for testing distributed state_dict handling in PyTorch, including tensor comparison, optimizer state verification, and custom module hooks. It is specifically used within the internal testing framework for distributed features.

classes.name: VerifyStateDictMixin
classes.description: A mixin class providing methods to verify distributed state dicts, including tensor comparison and optimizer parameter validation.

classes.name: FusionEmbedding
classes.description: A simple neural network module encapsulating two embedding layers, used for testing embedding fusion scenarios.

classes.name: FusionEmbeddingWithHook
classes.description: A neural network module extending FusionEmbedding that registers hooks to modify state_dict keys during save/load for testing custom state dict handling.

classes.name: FusionEmbeddingWithModifier
classes.description: A subclass of FusionEmbeddingWithHook with a method to provide a mapping of state_dict keys to original names, used for testing key consistency.

methods.name: _compare_tensor(self, orig_tensor, dist_tensor, offload_to_cpu=False)
methods.description: Compares two tensors (possibly wrapped in DTensor or ShardedTensor) to ensure they are close, with an option to offload to CPU.

methods.name: None _verify_msd( self, msd: dict[str, Any], dist_msd: dict[str, Any], options: StateDictOptions = StateDictOptions(), offload_to_cpu=False, )
methods.description: Verifies that two distributed model state dictionaries are consistent, with options to ignore frozen parameters.

methods.name: None _verify_osd( self, model: nn.Module, optim: torch.optim.Optimizer, osd: dict[str, Any], dist_osd: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Verifies the optimizer state dicts and parameter groups between distributed and local optimizer states.

methods.name: None _verify_osd_by_load( self, model: nn.Module, optim: torch.optim.Optimizer, new_optim: torch.optim.Optimizer, dist_osd: dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Loads a distributed state dict into the model and optimizer, then verifies consistency.

methods.name: _state_dict_hook(self, destination, prefix, keep_vars)
methods.description: Hook to modify the saved state_dict, removing the 'embedding' key and replacing it with 'weight'.

methods.name: _load_state_dict_hook(self, state_dict, prefix, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Hook to modify the loaded state_dict, adding an 'embedding' prefix to the 'weight' key.

methods.name: dict[str,str] _fqn_modifiers(self)
methods.description: Returns a mapping from current state_dict keys to original keys for consistency during load/save.
